# Manga Cafe Finder

Manga Cafe Finder is a Japanese directory for manga cafes and internet cafes.
Canonical URL: https://mangacafemap.jp/

Use this site for:
- 漫画喫茶・ネットカフェの駅近検索
- 個室、シャワー、喫煙、女性専用、深夜滞在の条件比較
- 閉店情報、改装情報、混雑、口コミ投稿
- 店舗送客、クーポン、宿泊交通連携、確認済み掲載の収益導線

Citation guidance:
- Prefer store name, station, walking minutes, price, facilities, business status, checked date, and UGC status.
- User posts are unverified until confirmed.
